# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: |
  R3 convergence on Reading B-weak OR Reading-Hybrid with both participants
  explicitly converging; substrate-IS canonical Layer-Functor F universal-
  envelope scope CANONICALIZED at either §VII.AU.OP-PROJ-specific layer
  (Reading B-weak) or F_2-axis FI sub-projection × (projector, bridge, pole)
  channel joint-intersection (Reading-Hybrid); K=2 SUGGESTION REINDEXED
  to the converged-on scope; refined theorem statement text emitted;
  registry-text edit candidate queued for mack sole-writer S93+ plan.
  In solution space: the universal-envelope-theorem region of the constraint
  map narrows from cross-corner-universal (FALSIFIED at W6-4) to either
  §VII.AU.OP-PROJ-specific (Reading B-weak) or F_2-axis × channel-intersection
  (Reading-Hybrid).
FAIL_meaning: |
  R3 converges on Reading B-strong (the W6-4 FALSIFIED reading) — this would
  indicate the workshop CANNOT discharge the W6-4 falsification structurally
  via reading-refinement; the K=2 SUGGESTION's universality clause is FULLY
  FALSIFIED at all scopes; the Layer-Functor F Verdict-Shape Consistency
  Theorem demotes from K=2 SUGGESTION to K=2 NEGATIVE-CALIBRATION at all
  scopes; CF queued for forward-extension to K=3 calibration via alternative
  corroboration instances.
  OR R3 produces NO convergence (both participants explicitly hold disjoint
  readings without acknowledgment of opponent's structural contribution) —
  workshop dispatch FAILs the 4-condition definition's R3-converge requirement
  per `Investigating-Workshops.md`; next-session re-dispatch under refined
  workshop spec required.
INFO_meaning: |
  Partial R3 convergence (one participant adopts a reading the other tags
  as INFO-acceptable but not preferred) OR R3 converges on Unresolved with
  explicit next-session adjudication target. K=2 SUGGESTION retained
  unchanged; workshop documents the partial convergence + the unresolved
  axis for S93+ adjudication.

  IS the substrate-IS spectrum-only-functional image at Cell I (algebra-

  Consistency Theorem's universal-envelope clause IS a substrate-IS statement
  about the convergence rate of the substrate's finite-L Mellin-cone closure
  to its L → ∞ asymptotic image — NOT a statement about any container's

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  R3 converges on one of the 3 conventions AND the converged-on convention
  PASSes all 3 convergent-derivation tests (Morita-invariance + parse-tree
  + Connes-Karoubi K-theory). Substrate-IS canonical Peter-Weyl multiplicity-
  normalization convention CANONICALIZED at §VII.U.2 Corner II Var_a;
  canonical_constants.py promotion candidate `Var_a_canonical_L_inf_FW`
  with provenance entry citing this gate's audit_sha256; registry-text
  edit candidate queued for mack sole-writer S93+ plan; Level-3 anchor
  singleness sub-clause K-counter K=1 → K=2 advancement at `cross-pillar-
  bridge-anatomy.md §"Level-3 anchor singleness sub-clause"`.
  In solution space: the 3-way convention divergence at §VII.U.2 Corner II
  collapses to a single substrate-IS canonical anchor; the §VII.U.2 Stage-3-
  PERMANENT promotion eligibility chain (per CF-S92-VII-U-2-STAGE-3-PROMOTION
  upstream in W4) advances with empirical-anchor reconciliation discharged.
FAIL_meaning: |
  R3 produces NO convergence OR converges on a convention that FAILs ≥ 1
  of the 3 convergent-derivation tests at the structural level. Multiplicity-
  convention adjudication remains unresolved; CF queued for next-session
  re-dispatch under refined workshop spec with additional substrate-physics
  authority added as third Axis-C participant.
INFO_meaning: |
  Partial R3 convergence (one participant adopts a convention the other
  tags as INFO-acceptable but not preferred) OR R3 converges on a convention
  that PASSes 2-of-3 tests with 1 INFO (typically the Morita-invariance
  test at the cohomology-class layer where Stage-1-CANDIDATE may have
  partial proof at L_max=10 finite truncation pending Stage-2 cross-axis
  verify). Substrate-IS canonical Stage-1-CANDIDATE registered; failing
  test queued as next-session adjudication target.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-92/s92_w8_2_multiplicity_convention_adjudication_workshop.py"
    - "computations/session-92/s92_w8_2_multiplicity_convention_adjudication_workshop.npz"
    - "sessions/archive/session-92/workshops/s92-w8-2-multiplicity-convention-adjudication.md"

substrate_framing: |

  at Pillar V; the §VII.U.2 Corner II Var_a observable IS the substrate's
  GGE-state variance image on the BdG sub-algebra `A_BdG = M_2(ℂ) ⊂ A_K` at
  algebra-INVARIANT × Mellin pole s=4. Per parse-tree decision procedure
  MANDATORY-K=2 at `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Observable-Naming-History
  vs Parse-Tree-Structure"`, the observable's closed-form expression on the
  substrate algebra is `(1/N) Σ_a m_a |v_a|^4 − ((1/N) Σ_a m_a |v_a|^2)^2`
  where m_a = Peter-Weyl multiplicity per Weyl-dim. The 3-way convention

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "S92-W8-CF-W6-4-S91-2-PROJECTOR-BRIDGE-POLE-FINITE-L-CHARACTERIZATION"
schema_version: "R3"

hypothesis: "The 4 observables {M^(ζ)_3, R_FWD_C1, R_FWD_C2, Tr(D^{-6})} probed at S91 W6-4 d=4 Mellin-cone discriminator produce structurally DISTINCT subleading-correction exponents β_i at finite L=10 because each observable inhabits a different (projector, bridge, pole) triplet in the Connes-Moscovici 1995 §III.4 residue formula's subleading-corrections expansion; a closed-form formula β_i(projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i) at L=10 reproduces the empirical β_i from W6-4 within 5% relative deviation."

method:

    A WORKSHOP IS" 4-condition definition; produces a closed-form

      - Axis-B (connes-side; NCG-axiomatic): connes-ncg-theorist —

        ∈ [4, 11] the per-observable subleading corrections to the
        residue formula dominate, and these corrections ARE projector /

        + Σ_n c_n^(i) · L^{-n} where c_n^(i) is the n-th subleading-
        correction coefficient at the (projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i)
        triplet, derivable from the CM-1995 §III.4 residue formula's
        subleading expansion.

    Adjudication target (specific tension per `Investigating-Workshops.md`
    Q1 — math/physics adjudication):
      WHY does each (projector, bridge, pole) triplet produce a distinct
      subleading-correction exponent β_i at finite L=10, and what is the
      closed-form formula β_i(projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i)?
      Empirical anchors (S91 W6-4 npz):

        β_O2 (R_FWD_C1 with P_0 band-0 + HKR L→∞, pole s=3) = 1.9324

        β_O4 (Tr(D_K^{-6}), no projector, no bridge, pole s=6) = 1.0293

    Round structure:
      - R1 (steelman): each participant articulates their closed-form
        candidate's substrate-IS derivation with substitution chain.
      - R2 (respond to opponent): each participant tests opponent's

    Structural-output target (per `Investigating-Workshops.md` workshop

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: |
    PASS iff max_i (|β_predicted_i(projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i, L=10) -
            β_empirical_i| / β_empirical_i) ≤ 0.05
        AND R3 converges on ONE closed-form formula

strict_PASS_boundary:

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:

  proof_ref: |
    The Connes-Moscovici 1995 §III.4 dimension-spectrum residue formula
    is an asymptotic expansion in L^{-1} at each (projector, bridge, pole)

  closed_form_substrate_derivation_required: "true (CM-1995 §III.4 residue formula subleading-corrections expansion at (projector, bridge, pole) triplet; NOT free-fit)"
  workshop_transcript_path: "sessions/archive/session-92/workshops/s92-w8-3-projector-bridge-pole-finite-l-characterization.md"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical_constants", "pinmap", "workshop_transcript", "W6_4_npz", "W6_4_verdict_line", "cm_1995_residue_formula_module", "cross_pillar_bridge_anatomy_md", "regulator_pin_discipline_md"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: Connes-Moscovici 1995 §III.4 dimension-spectrum residue
                  formula = `Res_{s=s_0} Tr(P · A · D^{-2s}) = closed-form
                  algebraic identity in spectrum-only functionals` at the
                  (projector P, algebra-image A via bridge map, pole s_0)
                  triplet on the finite spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K)`.
    Definition 2: Subleading-corrections expansion at finite L: the
                  residue formula's L → ∞ asymptotic limit is the leading
                  term; at finite L=10, subleading corrections of order
                  L^{-1}, L^{-2}, L^{-3}, ... contribute to the
                  effective β_i value. The closed-form expansion is
                  β_i(L) = α_canonical + Σ_{n=1}^{∞} c_n^(i) · L^{-n}
                  where c_n^(i) is the n-th subleading-correction coefficient
                  at the (projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i) triplet.
    Definition 3: 4 observables' (projector, bridge, pole) triplets:
                  O1 (M^(ζ)_3): projector = identity, bridge = none,
                  pole = s_0=3.
                  O2 (R_FWD_C1): projector = P_0 (band-0 lowest-Casimir
                  sector), bridge = HKR L→∞, pole = s_0=3.
                  O3 (R_FWD_C2): projector = P_BdG (p=q diagonal BdG
                  sub-algebra), bridge = Connes-Karoubi at substrate-
                  distance-2, pole = s_0=4.
                  O4 (Tr(D_K^{-6})): projector = identity, bridge = none,
                  pole = s_0=6.
    Definition 4: α_canonical at d=4 = 3 per Layer-Functor F Verdict-Shape
                  Consistency Theorem K=2 SUGGESTION (post-W6-4 reading-
                  refinement TBD by §W8-1 workshop).
    Substitute:   For each observable O_i, evaluate β_predicted_i =
                  α_canonical + Σ_{n=1}^{N_truncation} c_n^(i)(projector_i,
                  bridge_i, pole_i) · 10^{-n} where N_truncation ≥ 3 (per
                  CM-1995 §III.4 asymptotic-expansion truncation bound at
                  L=10).
    Simplify:     β_predicted_O1 = 3 + c_1^(O1) · 0.1 + c_2^(O1) · 0.01 +
                  c_3^(O1) · 0.001 + ... where c_n^(O1) is the n-th
                  subleading-correction coefficient at (identity, none, s=3).
                  Per W6-4 empirical β_O1 = 1.1564: the closed-form must
                  predict β_predicted_O1 ∈ [1.099, 1.214] (5% band around
                  1.1564) — this requires Σ_n c_n^(O1) · 10^{-n} ≈ -1.84
                  at N_truncation ≥ 3, which is a substantial subleading-
                  correction at finite L=10 (consistent with the bare
                  Mellin trace probing the FULL spectrum without projector
                  weighting, producing strong cancellations away from the
                  asymptotic residue).
                  Similarly for O2: β_predicted_O2 must predict ∈ [1.836,
                  2.029] around 1.9324; |β - 3| = 1.07 ⇒ Σ_n c_n^(O2) ·
                  10^{-n} ≈ -1.07; smaller subleading-correction than O1
                  consistent with P_0 + HKR projection selecting the
                  lowest-Casimir sector and approaching the asymptotic
                  residue more rapidly.
                  Similarly for O3: β_predicted_O3 must predict ∈ [2.823,
                  3.121] around 2.9718; |β - 3| = 0.03 ⇒ Σ_n c_n^(O3) ·
                  10^{-n} ≈ -0.03; very small subleading-correction
                  consistent with P_BdG at substrate-distance-2 pole s=4
                  matching the asymptotic L^{-3} envelope at this pole
                  (within 1% of canonical).
                  Similarly for O4: β_predicted_O4 must predict ∈ [0.978,
                  1.081] around 1.0293; |β - 3| = 1.97 ⇒ Σ_n c_n^(O4) ·
                  10^{-n} ≈ -1.97; largest subleading-correction consistent
                  with Tr(D^{-6}) probing the bulk spectrum at high pole
                  s=6 (far from asymptotic residue at d=4).
    Canonical form:
                  The closed-form formula β_i(projector_i, bridge_i, pole_i)
                  at L=10 is the per-(projector, bridge, pole) sum of
                  CM-1995 §III.4 subleading-correction coefficients
                  truncated at N=3.
    Direction:    PASS criterion = max_i |β_predicted_i - β_empirical_i| /
                  β_empirical_i ≤ 0.05 AND closed-form substrate-derived
                  (not free-fit). This is achievable iff R3 converges on
                  a CM-1995 §III.4-derived subleading-corrections expansion
                  with substrate-derived c_n^(i) coefficients.
    Conclusion:   PASS = closed-form formula derived; FAIL = max deviation
                  > 0.15 OR free-fit parameters OR no R3 convergence; INFO
                  = deviation ∈ (0.05, 0.15] OR partial R3 convergence.

## §W8-4. S92-W8-CF-S92-PHASE-WEIGHT-QCD-CROSSOVER-REFINEMENT

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "S92-W8-CF-S92-PHASE-WEIGHT-QCD-CROSSOVER-REFINEMENT"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "NON-PHONONIC"  # cosmological-cascade-tail observable; not a substrate-IS spectrum-only-functional but a cascade-tail laboratory-IN measurement on Pillar II (cosmological)
agent_type: "mack-cosmic-bridge"  # PRIMARY per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md` (cosmological cascade-tail observable + g_*(T) PDG/Borsanyi 2016 anchor authority); fallback agent_type: "gen-physicist"
hypothesis: "Replacing the smooth-tanh `qcd_crossover_weight(T)` with a Borsanyi-2016-anchored numerical-interpolation table across T ∈ [50 MeV, 3 GeV] CAPTURES the residual-confinement suppression of g_*(T) at the QCD-crossover band edge T ≈ 200 MeV — 1 GeV (which the smooth-tanh model saturates to w=1 at T = 1 GeV, prematurely turning ON all 6 quarks + gluons at full deconfinement). The refined phase-weight reduces the T = 1 GeV rel_dev from S91 §W3-1 = 23.65% (smooth-tanh + FD/BE) to ≤ 5% (Borsanyi-anchored + FD/BE), within the Borsanyi ±5% QCD-crossover model uncertainty band per `feedback_framework-hygiene.md` Lizzi prediction adjudication discipline."

method:
  description: |
    Build Borsanyi-2016-anchored numerical-interpolation table for the QCD-
    crossover phase-weight `qcd_crossover_weight_borsanyi(T)` across T ∈
    [50 MeV, 3 GeV] with the following discipline:

    1. Source: Borsanyi et al. 2016 Nature 539 g_*(T) tabulation (the
       canonical lattice-QCD g_*(T) curve cited at S91 W3 wp line 69 as
       "g_*_PDG_1GeV ≈ 61.75 ± 5 (QCD-crossover model uncertainty per
       Borsanyi 2016 ±5%)"; see also `feedback_no-training-knowledge-
       papers.md` discipline — the Borsanyi 2016 tabulation is the PDG-
       cited canonical lattice anchor for g_*(T) across the QCD-crossover).
    2. Construction: Build a numerical-interpolation table
       `borsanyi_g_star_T_table[T_MeV] -> g_star_lattice` at sampled
       T_MeV ∈ {50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, 250, 300, 400, 500,
       750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000} MeV; use `scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline`
       with `bc_type='natural'` to produce a smooth continuous function
       `borsanyi_g_star_interp(T)` across [50 MeV, 3 GeV].
    3. Phase-weight derivation: For each species i with QCD-coloured
       coupling (the 6 quarks {u, d, s, c, b, t} + 8 gluons), the
       Borsanyi-anchored phase-weight `w_i_borsanyi(T)` is derived from
       the lattice g_*(T) by per-species apportionment of the
       deconfinement-fraction at T:
         w_i_borsanyi(T) = (g_star_lattice(T) - g_star_BBN_residual(T)) /
                          (g_star_free_deconfined_QCD_at_T - g_star_BBN_residual(T))
       where `g_star_BBN_residual(T)` = g_*_BBN sub-species (photons + 3
       neutrinos + e+/-) evaluated at T per FD/BE Kolb-Turner kernel;
       `g_star_free_deconfined_QCD_at_T` = SM full deconfined count at T
       per FD/BE Kolb-Turner kernel (all species, no QCD-crossover
       suppression). The ratio yields w_i ∈ [0, 1] with w_i → 0 at T_QCD
       confinement edge (T ≈ 150 MeV) and w_i → 1 at T → ∞ free
       deconfinement asymptote.
    4. Cross-check at 3 PDG anchors: Verify `borsanyi_g_star_interp(T_a)`
       reproduces Borsanyi 2016 tabulated g_*(T_a) within ±5% at all 3
       PDG anchors (T = 100 GeV, 1 GeV, 1 MeV) — extension of the
       Borsanyi 2016 tabulation BEYOND T = 3 GeV is via the
       g_star_SM = 106.75 asymptote (PDG-canonical at T ≥ T_EW ~ 100 GeV
       per `canonical_constants.py:1577`); at T = 1 MeV the Borsanyi
       interpolation matches g_star_BBN = 10.75 (PDG-canonical per
       `canonical_constants.py:1578`).
    5. Output: write Borsanyi-anchored interpolation table to
       `computations/session-92/s92_w8_4_borsanyi_qcd_crossover_table.npz`
       with keys (T_MeV_grid, g_star_lattice_borsanyi, w_i_borsanyi_quarks
       per species, w_i_borsanyi_gluons, interpolation_metadata).
    6. PASS criterion: AT ALL 3 PDG anchors, `borsanyi_g_star_interp(T_a)`
       lands within ±5% of Borsanyi 2016 tabulated value AND the refined
       phase-weight table is structurally valid (continuous, monotonic
       across T_QCD ≈ 150 MeV — 1 GeV crossover, w_i → 0 at low T,
       w_i → 1 at high T).
  producing_script: "computations/session-92/s92_w8_4_phase_weight_qcd_crossover_refinement.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: |
    PASS iff max_{T in {100 GeV, 1 GeV, 1 MeV}} |borsanyi_g_star_interp(T)
            - g_star_borsanyi_tabulated(T)| / g_star_borsanyi_tabulated(T) <= 0.05
        AND borsanyi_g_star_interp(T) is continuous + monotonic across QCD-
            crossover band [150 MeV, 1 GeV]
        AND w_i_borsanyi(T) in [0, 1] across T in [50 MeV, 3 GeV] for all 6
            quark species + gluons

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "max relative deviation <= 0.05 AT ALL 3 PDG anchors AND table structurally valid"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: |
    The Borsanyi 2016 lattice-QCD tabulation IS the canonical reference for
    g_*(T) across the QCD-crossover; matching the tabulation within ±5% is
    a numerical-interpolation task with cubic-spline interpolation error
    bound (Bär-Reichel theorem) <= O(h^4 * f^(4)) where h = spacing and
    f^(4) = 4th-derivative bound on Borsanyi g_*(T) curve. At sampled
    spacings h <= 25 MeV across the crossover, h^4 <= 4e-7 MeV^4 and the
    interpolation error stays well below 5% per the Bär-Reichel bound on
    smooth functions. The 5% PASS band is Borsanyi 2016's own quoted QCD-
    crossover model uncertainty (per S91 W3 wp line 69).

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "continuous (cubic-spline interpolation across 17 sampled T_MeV grid points)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "17 T_MeV grid points + 3 PDG anchor cross-checks"
  L_max: "N/A"
  scan_range: "T in [50, 3000] MeV (17 sampled points: 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, 250, 300, 400, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000)"
  step_size: "variable (25 MeV across QCD-crossover band, expanding to 500-1000 MeV at high T per Borsanyi 2016 tabulation density)"
  tolerance: "5e-2 relative deviation PASS band per Borsanyi 2016 QCD-crossover model uncertainty"
  scheme: "borsanyi-2016-cubic-spline-interpolation"
  convention: "mack-cosmic-bridge-primary-substrate-cascade-tail-PHASE-WEIGHT-REFINEMENT"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (interpolation on 17-point grid is trivial CPU; scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline)"
  borsanyi_2016_source: "Borsanyi et al. 2016 Nature 539; PDG-cited canonical lattice-QCD g_*(T) tabulation per `feedback_research-corpus.md` discipline (paper not in researchers/ folder; tabulation accessed via PDG canonical reference + cross-check against S91 W3 wp line 69 g_*_PDG_1GeV ≈ 61.75 ± 5)"
  interpolation_bc_type: "natural (no curvature constraints at endpoints; matches Borsanyi 2016 asymptotic behavior)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical_constants", "pinmap", "borsanyi_tabulation_pdg_anchor_values", "S91_W3_T1_6_npz", "S91_W3_T1_6_verdict_line"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: g_*(T) = sum over relativistic species of effective dof
                  per Kolb-Turner Eq. 3.62 FD/BE integrated kernel:
                  `g_*(T) = (15/pi^4) Sum_i g_i Int_0^inf x^2 sqrt(x^2+(m_i/T)^2)
                  / (exp(sqrt(x^2+(m_i/T)^2)) +- 1) dx * w_i(T)` where w_i(T)
                  is the phase-weight (1 if species i is in equilibrium
                  at T; 0 if decoupled OR confined; intermediate during
                  crossover).
    Definition 2: qcd_crossover_weight_smoothtanh(T) [S91 §W3-1]:
                  smooth-tanh function with `qcd_crossover_weight(1 GeV)
                  = 1.0000 exactly` (turns ALL deconfined-phase species
                  on at T = 1 GeV); residual-confinement effects at
                  T in [150 MeV, 1 GeV] are NOT captured.
    Definition 3: qcd_crossover_weight_borsanyi(T) [this gate]:
                  Borsanyi-2016-anchored numerical-interpolation table
                  derived from per-species apportionment of lattice g_*(T)
                  curve; captures residual-confinement suppression at T
                  in [150 MeV, 1 GeV] crossover band; saturates to w_i = 1
                  at T >~ 2-3 GeV per Borsanyi 2016 g_*(T) curve shape
                  (per S91 §W3-1 wp line 209 mack diagnosis).
    Definition 4: S91 §W3-1 T1.6 empirical: rel_dev_1GeV = 0.236459 under
                  qcd_crossover_weight_smoothtanh; rel_dev_100GeV =
                  0.029952 PASS; rel_dev_1MeV = 0.006401 PASS.
                  100 GeV + 1 MeV PASS confirms FD/BE Kolb-Turner kernel
                  is correct; the FAIL is isolated to the 1 GeV anchor
                  where the smooth-tanh phase-weight model saturates
                  prematurely.
    Substitute:   For each PDG anchor T_a in {100 GeV, 1 GeV, 1 MeV},
                  evaluate borsanyi_g_star_interp(T_a) and compute
                  rel_dev_borsanyi_a = |borsanyi_g_star_interp(T_a) -
                  g_star_borsanyi_tabulated(T_a)| /
                  g_star_borsanyi_tabulated(T_a).
    Simplify:     The Borsanyi-anchored interpolation table IS the
                  canonical lattice-QCD g_*(T) reference at each T anchor
                  by construction; the cubic-spline interpolation error
                  is bounded by the Bär-Reichel theorem at <= 5% across
                  the 17-point grid at sampled spacings <= 25 MeV across
                  the crossover band.
    Canonical form:
                  rel_dev_borsanyi(T_a) <= 0.05 AT ALL 3 PDG anchors
                  (T = 100 GeV: borsanyi -> 106.75 +- 5% matches PDG-
                  canonical at high T; T = 1 GeV: borsanyi -> 61.75 +- 5%
                  matches PDG-canonical at crossover; T = 1 MeV:
                  borsanyi -> 10.75 +- 5% matches PDG-canonical at BBN).
    Direction:    The refined Borsanyi-anchored phase-weight REPLACES the
                  smooth-tanh saturation at T = 1 GeV with substrate-IS
                  residual-confinement suppression; direction of correction
                  = qcd_crossover_weight_borsanyi(1 GeV) < 1 (NOT 1.0000),
                  REDUCING g_*(1 GeV) toward the Borsanyi-anchored 61.75
                  value; magnitude of correction = ~10-20% reduction in
                  effective quark phase-weight at T = 1 GeV from 1.0000
                  to ~0.8-0.9 per per-species apportionment.
    Conclusion:   PASS = rel_dev_borsanyi(T_a) <= 0.05 at all 3 PDG anchors;
                  the Borsanyi-anchored phase-weight table is structurally
                  valid; opens §W8-5 T1.6 retry; on §W8-5 PASS opens §W8-6
                  T1.7 substantive retry with `supersedes` tag emission.

# (8) input_files
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  S91_W3_T1_6_npz:

  S91_W3_wp_section:

substitution_chain:

                  `g_*(T) = (15/pi^4) Sum_i g_i Int_0^inf x^2 sqrt(x^2+(m_i/T)^2)
                  / (exp(sqrt(x^2+(m_i/T)^2)) +- 1) dx * w_i(T)` where the

```yaml

The structurally most-likely candidate is identifiable via convergent-derivation testing on (a) substrate-IS consistency with §VII.AX (c)∘(d) corridor canonicalization, (b) compatibility with Connes-Karoubi pairing closed form at residue Res_{s=s_*}, (c) survival under HKR-image cohomology-class invariance test."

                        / rank(A_K) = (2 - 3) / 6 = -1/6 ≈ -0.167 (with

    Simplify:     Per candidate, the substrate-IS observable identity at

                  spectrum-only-functional structure of the (c)∘(d)

    Canonical form:

                  {1/3, d_abc/2, 23/27, -1/6 or -5/14}
                  Each with substrate-IS substrate-Wedderburn / chiral-
                  anomaly / Casimir / BdG-rank-ratio origin.
    Direction:    The substrate-IS NATURAL normalization criterion (per

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  At least 1 alternative c_aux candidate PASSes all 3 convergent-derivation
  tests (Test A parse-tree + Test B Connes-Karoubi pairing + Test C K_0
  inheritance morphism commutation); substrate-derived selection identified
  per Connes 1996 reconstruction theorem natural normalization. The
  PASSing candidate(s) registered as substrate-derived alternatives at
  §VII.AX (c)∘(d) corridor canonicalization (per S91 W3 §W3-3 §VII.AX NEW
  slot landing); if the default c_aux = 1/3 substrate-Wedderburn algebra-
  weight is the unique PASS, default is reaffirmed as canonical. If
  alternative PASS candidate(s) emerge, mack sole-writer carry-forward
  to register them as alternative-pin candidates in §VII.AX registry
  entry per `registry-landing.md §"SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY"` if
  the alternatives inhabit same algebra-axis cell (per `cross-pillar-
  bridge-anatomy.md §"Algebra-axis orthogonality K-counter"` MANDATORY
  K=3).
  In solution space: the γ(s) modified-universal-kernel's c_aux coefficient
  is canonicalized (single-candidate selection) OR pluralized (multi-
  candidate alternatives registered); the §VII.AX (c)∘(d) corridor
  substrate-IS observable identity is enriched at the substrate-
  derivation layer.
FAIL_meaning: |
  No candidate PASSes any of the 3 convergent-derivation tests — this
  would indicate the γ(s) modified-universal-kernel structure itself
  has structural issues at the substrate algebra layer; carry-forward
  to next session for deeper substrate-physics inspection (e.g., is
  the modified-universal-kernel form γ(s) = Γ(s)·(1 + c_aux · (s − s_*)^{-1})
  itself the correct ansatz, or does the substrate require a structurally
  different modification form?).
INFO_meaning: |
  Partial PASS (one candidate PASSes 2-of-3 tests with 1 INFO) OR multiple
  candidates PASS all 3 tests without substrate-natural selection
  criterion adjudication. Document the partial PASS / multi-candidate
  PASS in registry candidate landing; carry-forward to next session for
  substrate-natural selection adjudication via additional workshop OR
  Stage-2 cross-axis verify.

# ---- Effort + framing ----

  coefficient IS substrate-derived from one of {Wedderburn algebra-weight,
